title: Fare Reviews Counted Toward a Held-Out Amount, by Wayfare Pass Status (Wayfare Rides)
content:
When a rider pays an unpaid fare on **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)**, the review amount counted toward the held-out amount follows the **Wayfare Pass (rider membership)** membership in force at the request, and the fare reviews registered on the trip in submitted status.

## Rule

- Where the membership in force at the request is in trial, active or pending cancellation status, the requested amounts of **every** submitted fare review on the trip are added together.
- Where the trip had a membership in force at the request that is in any other status, only the requested amounts of submitted fare reviews registered against the unpaid fare charge itself are added together.
- Where the trip had no membership in force at the request, no review amount is counted, and the whole unpaid amount is collected.

| Membership in force at the request | Submitted fare reviews counted |
|---|---|
| in trial, active or pending cancellation status | every submitted fare review on the trip, whatever charge it is registered against |
| in any other status (for example paused or past due) | only submitted fare reviews registered against the unpaid fare charge |
| none | none — the whole unpaid amount is collected |

Only reviews in submitted status are counted; the requested amount is the amount entered on each review.

## Worked case (hypothetical trip)

A trip has two submitted fare reviews: $4.10 registered against the unpaid fare charge and $2.50 registered against the trip's wait time charge.

| Membership in force at the request | Review amount counted |
|---|---|
| active | $6.60 |
| past due | $4.10 |
| none | nothing counted |
